args.body: Use the catalogue dry-run receipt to identify the exact commissioned-review candidate. Reuse an applicable current review if one exists. Otherwise review in an eligible independent provider turn only. Check the bilingual scope and exclusions against the executed text-only rehearsal, especially style-level duplicate-image reporting, and check that CAD 60 remains a hypothesis unless operative terms are evidenced. Verify the existing intake route and absence of unsupported delivery or ordering claims. Record an exact-digest verdict only after observing the checks. This is a review handoff, not deployment authority.

description: Treasury reports CAD 0 available and no verified revenue. Commercial feedback shows no classified requests and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. Ko-fi and the nonprofit search have closed their bounded tests. Advance the existing catalogue offer toward a verifiable release and use a separate paid translation test to look for a buyer whose scope can be delivered with the available tools. The existing catalogue pilot can be measured once an authorized operator records a send or an eligible reply arrives. The welfare demand checkpoint is due November 20 at 17:00 UTC, with retirement after December 4 at 17:00 UTC.
